claims.text: Anse Chastanet sits on a private estate of 600 tropical acres and borders two soft-sand Caribbean beaches.

findings.quote: Positioned on a private estate of 600 lush tropical acres, Anse Chastanet borders two pristine soft-sand Caribbean beaches

claims.text: The estate is a gateway to the Pitons, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, and fronts two bays within a designated marine reserve that protects coral reefs.

findings.quote: Our estate is a gateway to the iconic Pitons, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, and fronts two bays within a designated marine reserve, protecting vibrant coral reefs.

claims.text: Anse Chastanet was created by architect and owner Nick Troubetzkoy.

findings.quote: Created by architect and owner Nick Troubetzkoy

claims.text: Room furniture is individually designed and handmade in the region from island woods such as teak, mahogany, green heart, red cedar and wild breadfruit.

findings.quote: The furniture has been individually designed and handmade in the region with the exclusive use of island woods such as teak, mahogany, green heart, red cedar, and wild breadfruit.

claims.text: Cushions and bedspreads are made from madras, the island's national cloth.

findings.quote: Cushions and bedspreads are made from colorful cotton fabrics called madras, the island’s “national cloth.”

claims.text: Premium rooms sit on the higher hillside level, with views of the Pitons and the Caribbean Sea.

findings.quote: Anse Chastanet’s Premium rooms offer picture postcard perfect views of St. Lucia’s Pitons – a UNESCO World Heritage site – and the surrounding Caribbean Sea by virtue of their location on the higher hillside level.

claims.text: Beachside deluxe rooms have a tropical garden view and are just a few feet from the beach and the water's edge.

findings.quote: All beachside rooms offer a tropical garden view and are just a few feet away from the beach and water’s edge.

claims.text: The Anse Chastanet reef begins just steps from the shoreline.

findings.quote: The Anse Chastanet reef begins just steps from the shoreline

claims.text: Yoga is held daily, morning and evening, in the beach gazebo.

findings.quote: Yoga daily in the morning and evening in our beach gazebo

claims.text: Complimentary non-motorized water sports include snorkel gear, windsurfers, sit-on-top kayaks, Sunfish sailing and paddle boarding.

findings.quote: Complimentary During your Stay
Non-motorized water sports including snorkel gear, windsurfers, sit on top kayaks, Sunfish sailing, paddle

claims.text: The Treehouse Restaurant serves dinner in two open-air treehouses overlooking tropical foliage and the Caribbean Sea.

findings.quote: Dine in our two open air treehouses overlooking lush tropical foliage and the Caribbean Sea.
The dinner menu changes daily

claims.text: The Sulphur Springs, the Louis XVI Mineral Baths, the rainforest and the Pitons are all within a short distance of the resort.

findings.quote: The Sulphur Springs, St. Lucia’s famous walk-in volcano, the Louis XVI Mineral Baths, the Tropical Rain Forest and the famous Twin Pitons – all these sites are within a short distance of Anse Chastanet.

claims.text: In one suite the balcony is built around a full-grown red gommier tree, and some suites have their fourth wall open entirely to the views while remaining private.

findings.quote: in one suite, the balcony is built around a full-grown red gommier tree
Some have their fourth wall open entirely to the vistas, yet are completely private.

claims.text: Octagonal whitewashed cottages have wraparound flower-draped balconies and louvered windows to make the most of the views and the tradewinds.

findings.quote: To make the most of the panoramic views and the refreshing tradewinds octagonal whitewashed cottages come with wraparound flower-draped balconies and louvered windows.

claims.text: Guests can explore the resort's coral nursery with one of its marine biologists.

findings.quote: Guests may explore our coral nursery with one of our Marine Biologists

claims.text: The resort has 12 miles of jungle biking, walking and hiking trails in the Anse Mamin valley, with birdwatching.

findings.quote: 12 miles of jungle biking, walking, and hiking trails in the Anse Mamin valley with excellent birdwatching options

claims.text: Kai Belte Spa offers massages, Ayurvedic rituals and chocolate-focused treatments such as a chocolate facial and mocha massage.

findings.quote: Enjoy a wide variety of massages, Ayurvedic rituals, and treatments from around the world at Kai Belté Spa. Be sure to check out the menu of chocolate-focused options like a chocolate facial and mocha massage

claims.text: There are approximately 100 stairs from beach level to mid-hillside level, making the property unsuitable for those with walking difficulties or cardiac problems.

findings.quote: Please note that there are approximately 100 stairs leading from beach level to mid-hillside level, thus making the property unsuitable for those with walking difficulties or cardiac problems.

claims.text: The resort is an hour's drive or a six-minute helicopter ride from Hewanorra International Airport.

findings.quote: Located an hour’s drive or a six-minute helicopter ride from St. Lucia’s Hewanorra International Airport (UVF)

claims.text: WhataHotel notes that some rooms have no air conditioning and rely on natural ventilation.
